entry.title: MPC Looper 0.6.1
entry.summary: MPC Looper is an experimental stereo VST2 insert for MPC Standalone: four independent disk-backed loops with pedal-style REC / OVERDUB / PLAY. - ARMv7 hard-float (Gen1) and AArch64 (Gen2), MPC OS **3.10.1+** with External Plugin Support. - Four loops, default recording length **4 bars**, maximum **32 bars**; overdub, undo/redo, individual and grouped transport. - Host tempo sync, optional Warp; PHASE or next-measure launch, MULTI/SINGLE playback, IMMEDIATE (default) / BEAT / MEASURE stop per loo
